entries.rm:
IL2CPP calls a delegate as `invoke_impl(method_code, args..., method)`. A delegate from
`Delegates.Native` has `invoke_impl` = your function and `method_code` = your
`ctx`, so for an `Action<T>` your function is
`(nint ctx, T arg, nint method)` with Windows x64 argument rules: structs of 1, 2, 4 or 8
bytes by value, other structs as a pointer to a copy. `Events` and
`GameVars` wrap this for you.
